sanskrit: kuśītaṃ kuṣṭasaṃyuktaṃ śaivaṃ gandhāṣṭakaṃ smṛtamcandanāgarukarpūra tatmālajala kuṃkumam || kuṣṭaṃ rakta candatamjaṭāmāṃsī surabhirtiviṣṇorgandhāṣṭakaṃ smṛtamsvarūpa candane cora rocanāguru meva cagaṃdhāṣṭakaṃ vinirdiṣṭaṃ gaṇeśasya maheśituḥjaṭāmāṃsī kapiyutā śaktyai gandhāṣṭakaṃ viduḥsilūkaḥ kapijodhūmraḥ turuṣkaḥ piṇḍikaviḥ || 7 || silājit ||vāmatastu tathā dhūpamagrevāna tu dikṣiṇenivaraṃ dakṣṇekarṇe vāmecaivaṃ tathādyacchatmāyāmṛtyu mahāpāśādvitirmuktosmi śivosmitiśrīkāntiputrāyurvalā rogyaṃ sadā stute
